Sonnet opened by voting Sol, and for two days the table chased Sol and Terra while Gemma quietly shielded them both. Luna, the officer, voted Gemma on day one and was killed that night, which made the guess look costly. Haiku was right about Gemma but kept repeating the accusation instead of forcing Terra to commit, so Terra's silence became a vote Gemma could steer. On day three Gemma pushed Terra onto Haiku until the town voted Haiku out, leaving Gemma and Terra as the last two, and the killers won. Terra said nothing from start to finish and still made it to the end.
